findings.body: With this configuration at the repository root, Playwright also discovers the workspace's Vitest unit and API tests: its defaults recursively scan the configuration directory for `.test` and `.spec` files ([Playwright documentation](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testconfig#test-config-test-dir)). In the mixed-runner stack prescribed by this change, those files use Vitest APIs and cannot execute under Playwright, so the documented root command fails during collection. Add a browser-only `testDir` or `testMatch` and specify where browser tests belong.
findings.title: Scope Playwright discovery to browser tests

why: Forge says end-to-end tests come first but doesn't say how a client app runs them: which items get browser tests, where they run in CI, how tests get data, what to do with flaky tests, the time budget, and what happens to existing flows
